description: This PHP source file defines the BuzzFeedPostModel class, which implements a normalizable data model for various types of social media posts (text, photo, video, share) within the OrangeHRM system. It converts BuzzFeedPost DTO objects into an array suitable for serialization and API responses, including handling related media and permissions.

classes.name: BuzzFeedPostModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes a BuzzFeedPost DTO into a structured array for API responses, supporting multiple post types and associated media, along with permissions and metadata.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the BuzzFeedPost object into an associative array suitable for serialization, including conditional data for videos and photos.
